name: FauxmoESP
description: fauxmoESP 3.4.1 (Amazon Alexa as a Belkin WeMo / Hue bridge) with LibreTiny (BK72xx) support: the ESP32 code paths with WiFi.h / AsyncTCP.h, the MD5 functions of the LibreTiny core instead of MD5Builder, and the SSDP listener on a lwIP udp_pcb instead of WiFiUDP (about 3.5 KiB less heap, closed while paused). ESP8266 / ESP32 code unchanged. The application provides ESPAsyncTCP / AsyncTCP.
